examples.en: She helped us selflessly.
He gave away all his money selflessly.
The police found an unidentified body.
They saw an unidentified flying object.
I get occasional back pain.
In the summer he finds temporary work.
The king signed the decree.
The new decree takes effect tomorrow.
This enzyme breaks down sugar.
A lack of the enzyme causes the disease.
He's a real train buff.
The fans were waiting in front of the stadium.
This job requires a lot of patience.
The situation calls for an urgent response.
The cyclist fell on the road.
There are a lot of cyclists on the path.
That is a logical conclusion.
The task requires logical thinking.

note: логичан means sensible, reasonable; логички relates to logic

examples.en: Turn the knob to turn up the heating.
This regulator keeps the temperature constant.
An abyss yawned beneath the bridge.
The country is on the brink of the abyss.
We must preserve nature for future generations.

examples.sr: Успео је да [очу̀ва] мир у породици.
examples.en: He managed to keep the peace in the family.
He was accused of blasphemy against the faith.
His words were sheer blasphemy.
He accepted the punishment with humility.
His humility impressed everyone.
This Japanese man is learning Serbian.
My colleague is Japanese.
He's an American from California.
There is one American in the group.
We dye eggs before Easter.
At Easter we're at Grandma's.
Our host is Greek.
Many Greeks come to Serbia in the summer.
My boss is Italian.
She met an Italian on the trip.

examples.sr: Она је [Нѐмица] и добро говори српски.
examples.en: She is German and speaks Serbian well.
My neighbor is German.
My teacher is Russian.
A well-known Russian woman lives in Belgrade.
My neighbor is a Serb.
That Serb lives in Moscow.
She is a Serb from Novi Sad.
My mother is a Serb.

note: Feminine of «Србин»; the plural of the masculine is «Срби»

examples.en: My friend is Turkish.
That Turk runs a bakery.

examples.sr: Тај [Фра̀нцӯз] већ годинама живи у Србији.
examples.en: That Frenchman has been living in Serbia for years.
The baker is French.
The Serbian alphabet has thirty letters.
The child is learning the alphabet.

examples.sr: Дали су ми [а̀ванс] пре почетка посла.
examples.en: They gave me an advance before the job started.
I'm asking for an advance of three months' pay.
The children are playing in the yard.
There is a big yard around the house.

note: colloquial, from Turkish; the usual word is двориште

examples.sr: Тост са [авока̀дом] је мој омиљени доручак.
examples.en: Avocado toast is my favorite breakfast.
An avocado is ripe when it is soft.

examples.sr: Заборавио сам [ада̀птер] за лаптоп код куће.
examples.en: I forgot my laptop's power adapter at home.
I bought an adapter for foreign sockets.
In the fairy tale, the hero kills the dragon.
His mother-in-law is a real dragon.

note: also used of a nasty, quarrelsome woman

examples.en: I need to update the app on my phone.
The data is updated every day.
The phone is asking for a system update.
The update takes ten minutes.
Children learn the alphabet in first grade.
The Serbian alphabet has thirty letters.
We adopted a dog from the shelter.
There are a lot of cats in the shelter.

note: азил за псе is a dog shelter; political asylum is also азил

examples.en: Her eyes are the color of aquamarine.
The ring with an aquamarine is very beautiful.
The painting was done in watercolor.
I bought paints for watercolor.
The ad is still current.
That is a very topical subject.

examples.sr: Ауто неће да упали, [акуму̀ла̄тор] је празан.
examples.en: The car won't start, the battery is dead.
I need to change the battery.
He has an acute inflammation.
Acute pain requires a doctor.
There is a lot of algae in the lake.

examples.sr: Морске [а̀лге] једу се у азијској кухињи.
examples.en: Seaweed is eaten in Asian cuisine.
We need to understand how the algorithm works.
The algorithm shows similar videos.
I'm allergic to pollen.
The child is allergic to walnuts.
The police stopped me for a breathalyzer test.
The driver tested positive on the breathalyzer.

examples.sr: [Алудѝрао] је на то да могу да отпутују.
examples.en: He hinted that they could leave.
Don't allude to my mistakes.

examples.sr: Изјава је била [а̀лӯзија] на прошли догађај.
examples.en: The statement was an allusion to a past event.
The song is full of allusions.
Good grief, what have you done!
I swear, I didn't say that!

note: from Turkish: a plea for mercy, a cry of surprise, an oath

examples.en: Plastic packaging goes in a separate bin.
Take the empties back to the store.
The ring has a purple amethyst.
The necklace is made of amethyst.
We are analyzing the data.
Experts are analyzing the situation.
I don't like pineapple on pizza.
Pineapple juice is sweet.
I'm allergic to anesthesia.

examples.sr: Зуб ми је извађен под локалном [анестѐзијом].
examples.en: I had my tooth pulled under local anesthesia.
Entertainers keep the children amused on the beach.
The singer got the audience going, and they started singing.

note: not just «to animate»: to entertain, to get people going

examples.en: We conducted a short survey among the students.
Please fill out the survey after the course.
I'm always anxious before an exam.
I feel anxious for no reason.
Anxiety won't let me fall asleep.
The doctor treats anxiety with therapy.
The doctor prescribed me an antibiotic.
Take the antibiotic every eight hours.
I carry a small antiseptic in my bag.
First clean the wound with antiseptic.
I topped up the radiator with antifreeze.
A good antifreeze is important in winter.
The audience applauded for a long time.
Everyone applauded the winner.
Download the app to your phone.
This app works even without the internet.
I applied for a job at a bank.
I want to apply for a scholarship.
Buy the medicine at the pharmacy.
It's as clean here as in a pharmacy.

meanings: final-year student who has passed all exams but not yet defended the thesis

examples.sr: Још сам [апсо̀лвент], тек треба да одбраним рад.
examples.en: I haven't graduated yet, I still have to defend my thesis.
As a final-year student I work part-time.
Where is the nearest pharmacy?

examples.sr: У [аптѐци] траже рецепт за овај лек.
examples.en: At the pharmacy they ask for a prescription for this medicine.
We paid for a package tour to Greece.
This package includes transport and accommodation.

note: at a travel agency: a paid package of transport and hotel

examples.en: The doctor suspects arrhythmia.
I get arrhythmia when I'm nervous.
The kitchen smells of fresh coffee.
This cheese has a strong aroma.
This item is on sale.
There are ten items on the receipt.
Hawaii is an archipelago in the Pacific.
Few people live on this archipelago.
Belgrade's architecture is very diverse.
He studies architecture in Novi Sad.
Turn on the range hood when you fry.
The new range hood is very quiet.
I don't believe in astrology.
She has been practicing astrology for years.
This tailor's shop makes custom suits.

examples.sr: Сликар ради у свом [атѐљеу] од јутра.
examples.en: The painter has been working in his studio since morning.
She's wearing a striking dress to the party.
This is an attractive job.
Black smoke is coming out of the exhaust.
The mechanic fixed the exhaust pipe.
The writer published an autobiography.
This autobiography is very honest.
The lights don't work, I'm calling an auto electrician.
The auto electrician replaced the battery.
The bumper is dented, we need a body shop.

examples.sr: После удеса сам одвео ауто код [аутолѝмара].
examples.en: After the accident I took the car to a body shop.
Our mechanic fixed the brakes.
I took the car to the mechanic.
For many people, hitchhiking is a great adventure.
We hitchhiked through Serbia.
The necklace is made of red agate.
I have one agate in my collection.
Take a spade and dig a hole.
I dug the garden with a spade.
Mom makes ajvar every fall.
Spread ajvar on the bread.
Come on, tell me what happened.

examples.sr: [А̀јде] да видимо шта ћеш да кажеш.
examples.en: Well then, let's hear what you have to say.

note: an imperative form, said to one person
tips: Ends a conversation: «Ајде, здраво!» means okay, bye then. With «више» it is an annoyed «come on already»: «ајде више».

examples.en: She drew a line with black eyeliner.
I can't go without eyeliner.
Let's go for a walk!
Let's get started.

note: includes the speaker: «let's do it together»

examples.sr: Мој брат је [ајти̏јевац] у великој фирми.
examples.en: My brother works in IT at a big company.
IT people earn good money.
The midwife helped with the birth.
My mother worked as a midwife.
Add a bell pepper to the salad.
We stuffed peppers with rice.
I bought the dress for peanuts.
For him it's nothing.

note: colloquial; «за багателу» means for next to nothing

examples.en: I bought a baguette and some cheese.
This baguette is still warm.
In May the black locust blossoms smell sweet.

examples.sr: Мед од [ба̏грема] је светао и благ.
examples.en: Acacia honey is light and mild.
I got the books for free.
All the effort was in vain.

note: from Turkish; «скоро за бадава» means almost for free

examples.en: I eat a handful of almonds for breakfast.
The cake is full of ground almonds.
After showering she put on a bathrobe.
Take a bathrobe to the spa.

note: from German Bademantel; a terry robe

meanings: Yule log (oak branch brought in on Christmas Eve)

examples.en: The men bring the Yule log into the house.
The Yule log symbolizes luck and health.

note: a young oak or oak branch, brought in on 6 January and put on the fire

examples.en: Cod is a fish of cold seas.

examples.sr: За ручак смо јели [бака̀ла̄р] са кромпиром.
examples.en: For lunch we had cod with potatoes.
The cable is made of copper.
Old copper gets covered with a green patina.
We had baklava with our coffee.
The baklava is too sweet.

examples.sr: Он је прави [ба̀ксуз], све му пође наопако.
examples.en: He's a real jinx, everything goes wrong for him.
Don't take the jinx to the exam!

note: colloquial, from Turkish; one who brings bad luck

examples.sr: Увече је у селу била велика [бакља́да].
examples.en: In the evening there was a big torchlight parade in the village.
The fans put on a flare show at the match.

note: a tradition on Christmas Eve and among sports fans

examples.sr: Беба се [ба̏лавӣ] јер јој расту зуби.
examples.en: The baby is drooling because she's teething.
The dog drools when it sees meat.
I wear ballet flats when I don't want heels.
She bought black ballet flats.
She put on ballet flats instead of heels.
Black ballet flats go with everything.
I bought black ballet flats.

examples.sr: У [балета̀нкама] можеш да ходаш цео дан.
examples.en: You can walk all day in ballet flats.
After shampoo, apply conditioner to your hair.
In winter I use lip balm.
The car stopped on the shoulder.
Don't drive on the shoulder.
I withdrew cash from the ATM.
Where is the nearest ATM?
Guests turned up at our place without warning.
I'll drop in on you in the evening.
The child jumped into the puddle.
Big puddles were left after the rain.

examples.sr: Он је права [бара̀ба], не верујем му.
examples.en: He's a real scoundrel, I don't trust him.

examples.sr: Где си, [бара̀ба], одавно те нисам видео!
examples.en: Where have you been, you rascal, I haven't seen you in ages!

note: among friends a joking greeting; to a stranger an insult
tips: The word comes from the biblical Barabbas. The dictionary says scoundrel, but in conversation it can also be jokingly affectionate.

examples.en: Vegetables should be blanched briefly.
Boil the eggs for eight minutes.

examples.sr: На путу је остала [ба̏рица] после кише.
examples.en: A puddle was left on the road after the rain.
The child is jumping in the puddle.
A banner is flying over the city.
He carried the banner at the head of the procession.
At a wedding the standard-bearer walks ahead of the guests.
My uncle was a standard-bearer at the wedding.
It's not nice to hit your brother.
Come here, bro, I'll show you.

note: children also use it for unfamiliar boys
tips: The vocative is «бато». Children also call unfamiliar boys this way: «бата» and «сека» instead of «дечак» and «девојчица».

examples.en: He got a thrashing from the older boys.
He deserved a beating.

note: «добити батине» means to get a thrashing

examples.en: Children were told about the bogeyman.
Don't be afraid, there is no bogeyman.

note: in the Serbian dub of «Шрек», the ogre is called баук

examples.en: His behavior is arrogant.
Don't be arrogant toward your colleagues.
Gardening relaxes me.
My hobby is gardening.
She brought a box of bajadera.

examples.sr: [Бајадѐра] се прави од орашастих плодова и чоколаде.
examples.en: Bajadera is made from nuts and chocolate.
The bread is stale, I'll make croutons.
I don't eat stale pastries.
They raised the banner in the square.
The uprising began under the banner.
Sokobanja is a well-known spa town in Serbia.
We're going to a spa for the weekend.
We're looking for a babysitter for the afternoon.
The babysitter brought the boys home from school.
That jacket is beige.
I like beige shades.
He had a carefree childhood.
In the summer we lead a carefree life by the sea.
That is an insignificant trifle.
The difference is insignificant.
What they're doing is an absolute outrage.
What an outrage! We stood there for two hours.
He is insensitive to other people's troubles.
Don't be so heartless toward her.
Whip the egg white to stiff peaks.
I only use the egg white.
Garlic goes into the sauce.
I don't eat garlic before a meeting.
Where is the nearest gas station?

examples.sr: Станимо на [бензѝнској пу̑мпи] да сипамо гориво.
examples.en: Let's stop at a gas station to fill up.
The grape harvest begins in September.
This year the harvest was plentiful.
I'm going to the barber to get my beard trimmed.
My barber works on Saturdays too.
At the seaside we wear Bermuda shorts.
His Bermuda shorts are plaid.
The professor spoke to a packed hall.
The bishop spoke at length about forgiveness.
An endless field lies before us.
I have endless patience.
The dog is vaccinated against rabies.

examples.sr: [Бѐснило] је опасна болест која се преноси уједом.
examples.en: Rabies is a dangerous disease transmitted by bites.
I've been short of money all month.
The country is in dire financial straits.
I feel helpless without my phone.

examples.sr: Беба је [беспо̀моћна] и зависи од мајке.
examples.en: A baby is helpless and depends on its mother.
Don't be an idler, help around the house.
He's a loafer, he doesn't do anything.
She has a bladder infection.
The doctor wants to examine her bladder.
Add salt and pepper.
A little pepper adds flavor.
She wears a lot of costume jewelry.
I bought some costume jewelry at the market.
I'm reading a biography of a composer.

examples.sr: У [биогра̀фији] пише да је рођен у Нишу.
examples.en: The biography says he was born in Niš.
On Friday we have a written test in biology.
She is interested in marine biology.
I use biodegradable bags.
That material is biodegradable.
Voters went out to vote early.
Every voter gets a ballot.

examples.sr: Свратили смо у оближњу [бѝртију] на пиво.
examples.en: We stopped at a nearby dive for a beer.
Mostly retirees sit in the tavern.

note: colloquial; a simple place: beer, rakija, coffee

examples.en: I'm into cycling.
Cycling is becoming more and more popular.
The tea is made from mountain herbs.
Grandma gathers medicinal herbs.
Tickets are bought at the ticket office.
The ticket office is open until six.
We wish you health and prosperity.
The country has reached a high standard of living.
I hid my face in embarrassment.
What a disgrace in front of everyone!

note: colloquial; «бламирати се» means to disgrace oneself

examples.en: What a disgrace!
The match was a real disgrace.

examples.sr: Не желим да се [бла̀мирам] пред свима.
examples.en: I don't want to embarrass myself in front of everyone.
He embarrassed me in front of the boss.

note: colloquial; «бламирати се» means to disgrace oneself

meanings: to make a fool of oneself
forms: бламирам се, бламирају се; pf. избламирати се

examples.sr: Не желим да се [бла̀мирам] пред свима.
examples.en: I don't want to make a fool of myself in front of everyone.
I really embarrassed myself yesterday.
I make juice in the blender.

examples.sr: Купили смо нови [блѐндер] за супе и сокове.
examples.en: We bought a new blender for soups and juices.
I don't trust him, he's just bluffing.
People often bluff in poker.

tips: Often followed by да: «мама је блефирала да је у питању старачки дом» - mom pretended it was about a nursing home.

examples.en: On weekends we have a proper chill.

examples.sr: Нема ништа боље од [бле̏је] на каучу.
examples.en: There is nothing better than chilling on the couch.
Tonight we're going to hang out at my place.
The ram is bleating in the meadow.

examples.sr: Они су [близа̀нци] и личе један на другог.
examples.en: They are twins and look like each other.
My aunt has twins.
The snow sparkles in the sun.
Her eyes shine with happiness.
We boil potatoes and chard.
Chard is sold at the market.
Turn off the flash, it's too bright.
You don't use a flash in the museum.
We picked berries in the forest.
A red berry hung on the branch.
It's not all that tasty.
Nobody knows, God knows where he is.
The child came down with chickenpox.
The vaccine against smallpox is mandatory.
A praying mantis is sitting on the leaf.
The children saw a praying mantis for the first time.
The lunch was divine.
You have a gorgeous dress.
Peonies are blooming in the garden.
I bought a bunch of peonies.
We drank cold boza at the market.
Boza is sweet-and-sour and thick.
He brought a pitcher of lemonade.
There is a carafe of wine on the table.

meanings: to be ill (for a long time)

examples.sr: Већ месец дана [бо̀лује] од упале плућа.
examples.en: He has been ill with pneumonia for a month.

examples.sr: Мама [бо̀лује] и не иде на посао.
examples.en: Mom is sick and isn't going to work.

note: of a long or serious illness

examples.sr: Колега је на [боло̀вању] већ недељу дана.
examples.en: My colleague has been on sick leave for a week.
I went on sick leave because of the flu.

note: «бити на боловању» means to be on sick leave

examples.en: He brought me a box of chocolates for my birthday.
There are twenty chocolates in the box.
Tall pines grow in the mountains.
The forest smells of pine.
He has small wrinkles around his eyes.
Laughter leaves wrinkles.

tips: Figuratively, wrinkles are the mark left by all of a person's worries and cares.

examples.en: I often stay at my grandmother's in the village.
He is staying abroad.
Foreigners register their place of residence with the police.
Temporary residence is valid for one year.
I like green bean soup.
I bought fresh green beans.
She wears a burgundy coat.
Burgundy suits her well.
We found a lot of blueberries in the mountains.
Blueberry juice is healthy.
Pizza is better with fresh basil.
Basil is growing in the pot.
The child colors the coloring book with colored pencils.
I bought a coloring book for the birthday.
I'm painting the wall blue.
Grandma dyes her hair every month.

note: not to be confused with «бојати се», to be afraid

examples.en: The child draws with colored pencils.
I lost the blue colored pencil.

note: usually plural: «бојице» is a set of colored pencils or crayons

examples.en: The citizens boycotted the elections.
Many people boycott that shop.
Turn off the water heater when you leave.
The water is cold, the water heater is broken.
I feel better today.
It's better to tell the truth.
This movie is better than that one.
I wish you a better life.

examples.sr: Позвали смо [бра̀вара] јер сам изгубила кључ.
examples.en: We called a locksmith because I lost my key.
The locksmith changed the lock.
The river is blocked by a high dam.
Behind the dam there is a large artificial lake.
He hit the rear bumper.
The bumper is scratched.
My nephew goes to school.
I bought a present for my nephew.
My niece is learning the piano.
My brother and niece are coming tomorrow.

examples.sr: [Бра̏те], не могу да верујем шта се десило!
examples.en: Bro, I can't believe what happened!
What's up, bro?

note: addressed to close friends of either sex; shows emotion

examples.en: We picked mushrooms in the forest.
Grandma is picking apples in the orchard.

note: for things growing in the wild or on trees
